Alex — thanks for the clear ask. TL;DR: we can do a staged upgrade with a blended term that preserves current quota while adding reserved capacity and a Priority SLA with measurable p95 credits. See attached MPA and SLA addendum v2 for the legal/commercial starting point.

Proposed approach:
- Terming: 12-month renewal with optional 6-month extension at pre-negotiated rate (you asked about 18 months in the call, can do — see optional term rows in the MPA).
- Capacity: Reserve an additional 2 GPU-equivalents during 08:00–20:00 PT; burst to 3x for 2-hour windows (up to 10% of monthly tokens).
- Latency SLOs: p95 <= 220ms for short prompts (<= 256 tokens). Missed SLOs trigger service credits per SLA addendum (sliding scale: partial credits for first breach, escalated credits for repeated breaches).
- Rollout: 2-week canary on a mirrored route, then staged migration over 3 business days, with a 30-day behavior watch and automated rollback if error/quality regressions occur.

Action items for ClearSight:
1) Confirm procurement contact for redlines (you included procurement@clearsight.ai — is that the primary?)
2) Pick term option (12-month default / 18-month locked discount)
3) Sign the SLA addendum (we can send as DocuSign or provide a redline).

Attachments: ClearSight_MutualActionPlan_Q3.xlsx, SLA_Addendum_v2.pdf

I’ll also schedule a 30-minute workshop with Ben (SRE/ops lead here) and Lauren (CS on onboarding) to walk the runbook and support rota. Marissa, feel free to chime on pricing cadence and any promotional credits.
